test_title: PYST 15: RRB ALP CBT I - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Nov 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) SA - PX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bca9020896afd97d3910882ab6f0c3bc72f60ee586c7f25aca10acf015d7df3.png] 

Option 2) LT - IQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9272de9f8182d92ea8c78c28ed6b8b1c3029c16748636aa93c6203be7556ec9.png] 

Option 3) TB - ZF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e852a6957f3113d151c3aca833ec5be11aa5d982fa8b79135e943af21eadfadb.png] 

Option 4) EM - BJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03775e92a5ebf867c0f1b73ac2145cbece5694bfb6f8f73d3aa572bc09a41cab.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'TB - ZF' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
